protocol.primary_outcome: selection_score with the strict both-context revisit bonus

multiplicity.method: Bonferroni over the two primary contrasts, two radii and two arms
multiplicity.secondary_outcomes: Strict and double-key strict comparisons use descriptive 95% intervals.

interpretation: Exploratory radius ladder chosen after the first test. Discovery estimates and random directions were reused without refitting, with unused worlds shared across all radii, arms, and their baselines. Paired intervals resample worlds and average the four fixed island champions within each world.
